# Adapter contract fixtures

These are synthetic, anonymized API-shaped examples, not captured live responses.
They exercise the explicit transport contract in the installed runtime guide:
GitHub REST comment arrays and Link-header cursors, ADO comment pages, and Linear
GraphQL comment connections. They do not certify any MCP server version, storage
round trip, identity verification, or permission setup. Live preflight must retain
its actual server version, response metadata, and reviewed evidence separately.
